cross_group_reviews.assessment: CM2/16/75 and KG145/166/174 preserve explicit D or D-(+) qualifiers. CHEBI31345 and calcium:pantothenate stoichiometry support the D-hemicalcium alias without inferring hydration. Unsafe DL/capsaicin labels are rejected in the concrete shared owner. B75 remains limited by the metadata-only P5 primary response; CM49/77 and historical conflict70 are excluded.

CM15/41 and C124 preserve D stereochemistry without anomer or hydration. C124 retains the live JCM490/TOGO491 recovery gap; frozen spelling plus verified ontology supports only the bounded raw alias. This does not identify alpha glucose B79 or alpha monohydrate KG146.

CM25 and KG170 share explicit LaCl3 seven-water source form and CAS10025-84-0. The separate form-specific CAS identity and asymmetric parent mapping preserve the hydrate; no whole lanthanide-stock identity is inferred.

CM35 and KG183 are the explicit Merck108339 broth in DSMZ1429 at30g/L. Current supplier typical composition is two5g/L peptone fractions plus20g/L D(+)glucose after reconstitution. Historical lot/version concordance remains unknown; generic Sabouraud family and separately added agar remain distinct.

All four exact source recipes name a generic1M glucose stock. Directly reread JCM548/1136/1406/1412: autoclaving is explicit, but only548/1412 state stock storage underN2. Payload preserves these source-specific preparation differences and unknown anomer/hydrate; it does not turn generic glucose into a D-specific solid.

A31 and B81 expressly name ATCCMD-TMS. The current fifteen-solute formulation is date-qualified, has cobalt nitrate and anhydrous alum, and is explicitly distinct from the conflicting older Wolfe owner. The link is catalogue-qualified product context, not retrospective proof of current constituent concentrations in historical media. Case0 remains excluded.

Directly reread JCM576 and recovered MediaDiveJ576: solution4409 recipe entry1812 adds1ml SL12, and separate stock4411 contains the same ten printed inputs as JCM576. This binds A8/KG180 while preserving EDTA hydration uncertainty and the tenfold frozen percentage error. DSMZ998 and unspecified SL12 usages are excluded.

Directly reread CCAPR75S PDF:1g dried milled ryegrass is boiled in75%seawater and then filtered; ingredient2362 also specifies dried,milled. A44/KG169 share the plant input, not the filtered infusion or a taxon. Existing UNMAPPED owner and botanical/procurement limits remain.

Cases47/90/107/144 refer to yeast extract, supported by the full TOGO2497 annotation and NBRC1140/TOGO2529 spellings. This reviewer authored the combined B payload; science approval is solely the separately hash-bound A-v6 and root combined-owner reviews. Fresh25% preparation58 and whole yeast biomass9/168 remain separate.

Cases52/134 explicitly link the complete matching NBRC1257/1321 and JCM439 trace tables. Source-specific7.7M HCl wording is attributed only to NBRC;25% is printed in both. Reviewer authored this B payload and does not self-approve its science; A-v6 and root combined-owner reviews bind final bytes.

B54/KG157 are the same MediaDive460-derived historical Difco5577-15 TC preparation in DSMZ403, with baseline owner continuity. The existing owner edit retains UNMAPPED and adds bounded catalogue/form evidence. It does not identify a successor255772 or generic yeast extract. B authored the payload; A-v6 approves exact bytes and C separately reviewed KG157 applicability.

C102 and six B71 JCM recipes preserve Sheffield typeA despite capitalization and punctuation differences. The combined raw aliases retain UNMAPPED/UNDEFINED_MIXTURE. SigmaC7290/C0626, generic hydrolysate and typeB are not inferred equivalent.

C106/KG152 retain explicit Medium187 references, including source punctuation truncation. JCM187 defines this stock, and primary ingredient1886 supplies the exact label. Generic trace-element terms and historical molecular-name collisions remain excluded.

C110, A22 and KG182 resolve explicit151 references via their exact source chains. The final payload promotes only the established whole stock to its own local registry identity; components, variable manganese hydration, alum wording, KOH and batchwater remain literal. This does not establish ATCCMD-TMS equivalence or child chemical identity.

C123, B65/B85 and KG165 explicitly reference284 vitamins. The final source-defined local registry retains DL pantothenate/highB12 and remains distinct from197 vitamins and284 minerals. B85 primary1ml per1004ml versus tenfold frozen percentage discrepancy remains recorded.

C111/117/101, A21, B76, KG177 and exactly three B57 occurrences share the separately verified197 ten-vitamin formulation. NBRC837 source quantities match, while its aseptic/anaerobic addition is not conflated with JCM197 explicitN2 stock gassing. The RM B57 occurrence is excluded and has its own three-vitamin proposal. No global generic Trace vitamins alias; all84 KG177 downstream holds are preserved.

A9/KG168 are DSMZ958 whole baker-yeast paste measured by wet weight. The corrected payload explicitly retains deionized-water washing, and C independently reviewed the delta. No species, strain, soluble extract or dry-biomass identity is asserted.
